description: This file defines the `ProjectResource` class, a data transfer object (DTO) for project-related data in a REST API context, including project ID, title, start date, and end date with their respective getters and setters.

classes.name: ProjectResource
classes.description: A data transfer object representing project data exposed via REST API, including properties for project ID, title, start date, and end date with corresponding getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getDateStarted
methods.description: Returns the date when the project started.

methods.name: setDateStarted
methods.description: Sets the start date of the project.

methods.name: getDateEnded
methods.description: Returns the end date of the project.

methods.name: setDateEnded
methods.description: Sets the end date of the project.
